//_antenna_history: run_2 (no heuristic insertion, 1 GRT pass) = 129 pin / 86 net antenna violations, 950 diodes, clean DRVs. run_4 (heuristic threshold 90 + DIODE_INSERTION_STRATEGY 3) = 9 pin / 9 net, but 22826 diodes, 687 max-slew and 2151 max-fanout violations. The blanket insertion traded one problem for another: a diode on ~every input pin doubles each net's pin count and load, and it is added AFTER the resizer has finished, so nothing repairs the damage.
//_antenna_now: v7.2 keeps the iterative, targeted OpenROAD repair and raises the heuristic threshold so diodes go only on genuinely long nets instead of everywhere. Tune HEURISTIC_ANTENNA_THRESHOLD with the ladder in check_signoff.py: start 250; if antenna violations remain, step 250 -> 200 -> 150; if slew/fanout violations appear, step back up. Verify every run with: python3 check_signoff.py runs/<run>
//_diode_strategy: DIODE_INSERTION_STRATEGY is deliberately NOT set. It is deprecated in OpenLane and value 3 duplicates what RUN_HEURISTIC_DIODE_INSERTION already does, which is how run_4 ended up with 22826 diodes.
//_decap: Drop sky130_ef_sc_hd__decap_12 from the default DECAP_CELL list. It is an efabless-generated cell with no subcircuit in the PDK CDL, which made CVC/ERC abort with 'could not find subcircuit ... (sky130_ef_sc_hd__decap_12)' and left cvc_total_errors = -1 in run_4. The four sky130_fd_sc_hd decap cells below are all present in the CDL, so ERC can complete.
//_klayout_drc: run_4 skipped KLayout DRC entirely ('KLAYOUT_DRC_TECH_SCRIPT is not defined ... will be skipped') and reported klayout_violations = -1. The sky130A PDK ships the runset but does not populate this variable. Point it at the runset explicitly. If the flow still skips the step on your OpenLane version, run OpenLane/secure_asic_top/run_klayout_drc.sh after the flow instead.
//_signoff: Keep every signoff check explicitly on so each run regenerates its own DRC/LVS/XOR/ERC evidence.
